record.question: FM broadcast band lies in -
record.explanation: Ordinary FM broadcasting occupies roughly 88–108 MHz, within the 30–300 MHz VHF band. It is not in UHF,SHF or HF. Reference: https://www.acma.gov.au/bands-broadcasting-services; https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CFR-1997-title47-vol4/pdf/CFR-1997-title47-vol4.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
